core_problem_solved: To parse potentially malformed, real-world HTML into a clean stream of SAX events or a DOM tree, by correcting for common syntax errors like unclosed tags.
key_features: Tag balancing to fix malformed documents
Implements standard parser interfaces (SAX, DOM) via wrappers
era_and_niche: An early and important error-tolerant HTML parser for Java, used by other tools and frameworks (like Apache Xerces) that needed to process messy HTML as if it were clean XML.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. It was superseded by the more standard coordinate **`net.sourceforge.nekohtml:nekohtml`**. Furthermore, the entire NekoHTML project itself has been largely superseded by the more modern and feature-rich HTML parser **`jsoup`**.
